annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley de Reforma Constitucional que establece el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial como uno de los principios de la administración de justicia
annotation.title_en: Constitutional Reform Bill establishing the use of Artificial Intelligence as one of the principles of the administration of justice
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República del Perú (Congresista Jhakeline Katy Ugarte Mamani)
annotation.venue: Congreso de la República del Perú
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian congressional bill proposing a constitutional amendment to Article 139 adding the use of artificial intelligence for resolving judicial cases and routine procedural actions as a principle of the judiciary. The explanatory memorandum cites Latin American judicial AI tools and argues for efficiency and access to justice.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Article 139 of the Peruvian Constitution to add item 23 on AI use in judicial case resolution and routine procedural actions.
Aims to accelerate judicial processes and reduce procedural backlog.
Cites tools such as Prometea, VICTOR, PretorIA, Fiscal Watson and the 'Justo' judicial assistant robot.
States AI decisions are not autonomous but follow human programming.
Claims no cost to the State; enters into force the day after publication.
